additional_info.subject: RE: ID0429312-DC/Si-D/CH-[RVP/T2170004480]Loss of comunication CRM:02698000221
additional_info.body:
Dear José Martin,
I hope this message finds you well.
I wanted to inform you that the charger was displaying a communication error due to an issue with SECC,
outlets were temporarily unavailable due to a COAP error.
We’d like to inform you that the COAP error you’ve encountered is due to a  interruption in internal communication between the SiC D and the SECC.
The issue has been resolved, Outlets are available now.
I trust that  your  query has been addressed, and you are satisfied with the provided answer.
The charger is now healthy, with no active error flags, and all outlets are available.
Can we proceed with case closure?
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
